reviewer: Independent technical agent /root/technical (AI-assisted review, not external certification)
scope: FIFO preparation carryover, deferred audit/capability/prototype availability, common readiness/capacity acquisition stop, daily/cumulative capacity conservation, task/cash retention, and unsupported-overrun rejection.
changes_made_by_reviewer: No economic engine, protocol, numerical source, or experimental result changes. This review receipt only.
identities_checked: Each day: gross capacity = preparation consumed + production reserved + unused capacity.
Each day: opening backlog + newly committed preparation = preparation consumed + closing backlog.
Every prefix and horizon: total committed preparation = total consumed preparation + unfinished backlog.
Every prefix and horizon: total gross capacity = total preparation consumed + total production reserved + total unused capacity.
Available offerings and active specialist mode equal only tasks completed by that day.
Profit = collections - complete A/B/C costs; available funds = seed capital + profit - reserves.
semantic_findings: Setup completion gates the first audit. Exact-boundary completion does not create extra production capacity.
Forced and selective commitments preserve a distinct committed target and active mode; repeated checkpoints do not duplicate pending investment.
Prototype outcomes are revealed at completion only. Pending and failed prototypes retain committed cash charges and all consumed capacity.
Zero-duration tasks complete at zero capacity while positive-duration tasks remain pending.
The acquisition gate is common to all six policies and executes before hidden lead fields are accessed.
Ordinary-library and shared-work paths, cash, costs and preparation records remain exactly identical on the existing development seed across all scenarios.
Realized numerical work exceeding its declared reservation raises ValueError; it is not clipped or silently omitted from a returned result.
interpretation_limits: The task ledger models assumed preparation reservations; it is not a measurement of real enterprise capacity or labor.
Production_reserved_seconds is conservative capacity reservation, not measured CPU consumption. Model/preparation reservations remain assumed.
Calendar upkeep remains charged on the committed specialist target even while preparation is pending; this preserved cost assumption is explicitly labeled in the engine.
acquisition_capacity_holds counts halt events, not the number of unseen leads censored.
Unsupported duration overruns invalidate the simulation run. This edition does not model overrunning production as new queued work.
These software tests do not validate demand, willingness to pay, prices, market size or commercial profitability.
No protected 11000-cohort seed or result was used in this review.
release_recommendation: The reviewed engine is ready for the declared correctness-amendment freeze and separately authorized fresh confirmation. No further policy tuning is recommended.

final_export_binding.method: Reversed only the four descriptive capacity_paths export changes in memory. The reconstructed full source hashes exactly to the independently tested engine. No file was rewritten during comparison.
final_export_binding.refined_export_semantics: mode_ready_fractions requires completed common setup; all readiness values are end-of-day after preparation, and do not imply remaining production capacity.
final_export_binding.ready_offerings_schema: Unchanged horizon count of currently ready offerings; capacity_paths offers remains its per-day mean. The new fractions derive only from the corresponding ready_offers membership.
